name: check-the-maps
description: A fast, low-cost pre-flight check for Copilot prompts. Clear prompts go straight through; vague ones get quick questions and a suggested rewrite, using MAPS (Mission, Ask, Parameters, Shape).

chatParticipants.name: maps
chatParticipants.description: Your prompt is checked, then sent to Copilot

commands.description: Check a prompt without sending it

commands.name: send
commands.description: Skip the check and send straight to Copilot

commands.name: explain
commands.description: What MAPS means and when each part matters

checkTheMaps.autoSend.markdownDescription: Send prompts that pass the check to Copilot automatically. When off, a passing prompt shows a **Send to Copilot** button instead.

enumDescriptions: Only flag prompts that are likely to go wrong. Fewest interruptions.
Flag prompts that leave out something important for their size.
Flag any prompt that skips a MAPS element its size needs. Good for learning MAPS.
checkTheMaps.strictness.markdownDescription: How picky the check is. Small, specific requests (like renaming a function) always pass.

checkTheMaps.model.markdownDescription: The id of the model that checks your prompts. Leave empty to use the cheapest model with a known price; a premium model is never picked automatically. [Choose Checker Model](command:checkTheMaps.chooseModel) shows every available model with its cost per check.

checkTheMaps.keepMapsInChatBox.markdownDescription: After a prompt is sent to Copilot, put `@maps` back in the Chat view's chat box so your next prompt is checked too. Delete it to send a prompt without a check.

checkTheMaps.sendInMode.markdownDescription: Chat mode to send passing prompts in, such as `agent` or `ask`, or the name of a custom agent. Leave empty to keep whatever mode the chat is in. Note that switching into or out of `edit` mode can start a new chat session.

checkTheMaps.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds to wait for the checker before sending the prompt on unchecked. Checks usually take one to two seconds.

checkTheMaps.dailyCheckLimit.markdownDescription: Most model checks per day. After that, prompts are sent on unchecked. Prompts that pass the local rules don't count. Set to `0` for no limit.

checkTheMaps.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the MAPS item in the status bar, with a green check after a passing prompt.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Check The MAPS
walkthroughs.description: Catch vague prompts before they cost you a round of rework.

steps.title: Check your first prompt
steps.description:
Start a chat prompt with @maps. Clear prompts go straight to Copilot with a small ✅. Vague ones get a few quick questions and a suggested rewrite.
[Start a Checked Prompt](command:checkTheMaps.startCheckedPrompt)

steps.title: Pick the checker model (optional)
steps.description:
By default, the cheapest model with a known price checks your prompts, at a tiny fraction of a credit per check. You can choose a different one.
[Choose Checker Model](command:checkTheMaps.chooseModel)

steps.title: Tune how strict it is
steps.description:
Lenient is the default and interrupts least. Strict is good while you're learning MAPS.
[Set Strictness](command:checkTheMaps.setStrictness)

steps.title: Learn MAPS
steps.description:
Mission, Ask, Parameters, Shape: what each one means and which requests need it.
[What Is MAPS?](command:checkTheMaps.explain)
